title: Public Parking Facilities
previewText: In C2-5, C2-8 and C6 Districts, the provisions of Section 32-19 (Use Group IX - Storage), inclusive, with respect to public parking garages and public parking lots are inapplicable and are superseded by the provisions of Section 93-80 (OFF-STREET PARKING REGULATIONS).
